text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko on, wata on juulu hara hiɗon siwri haa ɗiwton e ngon siwrugol anndon ko wowloton -ɗum ko ado sanngara harminireede pellital - Wata on juulu kadi ko on modduɓe janaaba, wata on naatir non kadi ka juulirɗe si wanaa hara on feƴƴay woni haa lootoɗon. Si on woni e nawnraare haɗaynde on huutorgol ndiyam, maa hara ko on setiiɓe, maa goɗɗo e mun yehi ɓaawo hoggo, maa hara on renndo e rewɓe ɓen ; roŋkuɗon ndiyam, faandoree taamoragol leydi laaɓundi : mowlon geece mon ɗen e juuɗe mon ɗen. Pellet, Alla Laatike Haforoowo palje mon, Yawtanoowo on.
